critique.evidence: The section is visually cohesive and demo-ready: strong editorial headline, disciplined dark palette, crisp cyan/green status accents, consistent mono labels, and clear BLOCK→ALLOW hierarchy. Desktop uses the split evidence panel effectively; tablet reflows cleanly; mobile preserves the system without horizontal page overflow. Deductions: mobile becomes excessively tall and repetitive, secondary text is quite small/low-contrast, and the global header feels clipped rather than intentionally responsive—tablet/mobile hide the active Memory destination off-canvas, while the desktop rail crowds its final item against Red Mode.
critique.fix: Make the header’s active destination persistently visible at tablet/mobile widths, and tighten the mobile precedent rows into a denser two-column or inline metric treatment. Slightly raise secondary-text size/contrast and give the desktop header’s last navigation item clear separation from Red Mode.
